neighbours.label: causative 'have' in a teacher's instructions: the teacher has the students do something
fire: For homework, the instructor can have the pupils read the next chapter.
After the lecture, I like to have my students summarize the main idea.
Teachers might also have the class vote on the best design.
During the lab, the teacher will have students record each measurement.
To review, you could have learners quiz each other in pairs.
At the end of the unit, we have the children present their posters.
Before the test, the tutor may have each student solve one problem aloud.
In this lesson, teachers should have pupils label the parts of a flower.
quiet: For homework, the pupils read the next chapter of the novel.
After the lecture, my students usually have lots of questions.
Teachers might also vote on the best design for the poster.
During the lab, students carefully record each measurement.
To review, learners quiz each other in pairs at their desks.
At the end of the unit, the children present their posters.
Before the test, each student solves one problem aloud.
In this lesson, pupils label the parts of a flower.

notes: Card: 'choose to have their students', '- Have students learn', 'Next the classroom divides'. Probe: 'may choose to have their students write' 0.32; sentence-initial 'Have students' 0.02; non-classroom causative 'have the car washed' 0.01. So test mid-sentence classroom causatives.
